description.value:
After countless castings, your most practiced spells begin to summon forth like a reflex; effortlessly and with startling quickness.

Whenever you cast a cantrip with one or more charge options applied to it, reduce its total mana cost by 1 (minimum 0).

In addition, when a creature triggers an attack of opportunity from you, you can use your reaction to cast a cantrip at the creature instead of making a weapon attack. The cantrip must have a casting time of 1 action or less and must only target that creature. Cantrips with a ranged spell attack do not suffer disadvantage from the target being within 5ft of you when cast using this ability.
